title: Visiban Helm chart values
description: Structural contract for the Visiban chart's values (#1116). The ROOT is additionalProperties:false on purpose: Helm silently accepts a values key no template reads, so a wrong or invented top-level key -- a typo, or a name lifted from another chart's docs -- used to change nothing on the pod while the operator believed it was applied. That failure is indistinguishable from the setting having no effect, and it fails identically for the next wrong key. Blocks the chart hands wholesale to a subchart or to toYaml (global, backend.resources, frontend.resources, backend.securityContext.pod/.container, postgresql.securityContext.pod/.container, ingress.annotations, postgresql, valkey) stay OPEN, because the chart is not the authority on what is valid inside them. No key is 'required': values.yaml supplies a default for everything the chart reads, and the render-time guards in templates/_validate.tpl own the cross-field rules a JSON Schema cannot express (placeholder SECRET_KEY, placeholder allowedHosts, smtp-without-a-From-address).

global.description: Values shared with the bundled subcharts. Open by design -- Helm's global block is a cross-chart channel, not something this chart can enumerate.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names and labels.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full release-scoped resource name prefix.

backendReplicaCount.description: Number of backend (Django/daphne) replicas. >1 also enables pod anti-affinity and a PodDisruptionBudget.

frontendReplicaCount.description: Number of frontend (nginx) replicas. >1 also enables a PodDisruptionBudget.

tag.description: Image tag. Must be a pinned tag -- 'latest' is rejected so an operator cannot end up with two replicas on different builds (#542).

debug.description: Django DEBUG. A string, not a boolean: it is passed through to an env var and django-environ parses the string.

maxUploadSizeBytes.description: MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_BYTES. Both transport limits (nginx client_max_body_size, ingress proxy-body-size) are derived from the larger of this and importMaxSizeBytes, plus 10 MB of framing headroom.

importMaxSizeBytes.description: VISIBAN_IMPORT_MAX_SIZE — maximum Trello JSON export size for the board import wizard, in bytes. Also feeds the derived transport limits.

numProxies.description: NUM_PROXIES (#1180): reverse proxies in front of the backend that append to X-Forwarded-For. null (default) renders nothing and keeps the backend default of 1; 2 behind a Cloudflare Tunnel (values-demo.yaml).

migrate.description: Timeouts for the `migrate` init container on the backend Deployment (#1117). It waits for the database to accept connections, then takes a PostgreSQL advisory lock so concurrent replicas cannot migrate at the same time. Both waits are bounded so a stuck deploy reports a named timeout instead of hanging.

connectTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for the database to accept a connection before failing the init container.

lockTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for another replica's in-flight migration to finish before failing rather than starting against a possibly half-migrated schema.

resources.description: Passed through with toYaml. Open: the chart is not the authority on the ResourceRequirements schema.

securityContext.description: Pod- and container-level securityContext for the backend Deployment (#1210). Passed through with toYaml, like resources above -- the chart is not the authority on the PodSecurityContext/SecurityContext schema.

resources.description: Passed through with toYaml. Open, as backend.resources.

annotations.description: Merged after the chart's derived proxy-body-size annotation, so an operator entry of the same name wins. Open: arbitrary controller annotations are the point.

postgresql.description: OPEN, deliberately. This block is shared with the bitnami/postgresql subchart, which reads far more keys than this chart does -- closing it would reject every legitimate subchart value. The keys listed below are the ones VISIBAN's own templates read; they are typed so a wrong type still fails, while unknown keys pass through to the subchart.

enabled.description: Use an in-cluster PostgreSQL (either the bundled StatefulSet or the subchart). false requires externalDatabase.

subchartEnabled.description: Deploy the bitnami/postgresql subchart instead of the chart's own StatefulSet.

securityContext.description: Pod- and container-level securityContext for the bundled PostgreSQL StatefulSet (#1210), not read when subchartEnabled is true. Passed through with toYaml -- the chart is not the authority on the PodSecurityContext/SecurityContext schema.

valkey.description: OPEN, deliberately. Until chart 0.5.0 (#1200) this block configured the bitnami/valkey subchart, and existing values files may still carry its keys; closing the block would fail their helm upgrade. Those keys are no longer read (docs/administration/upgrade.md), and the ones that would change what runs (architecture, auth, a Bitnami image) are refused by _validate.tpl. The keys below are the ones templates/valkey.yaml reads; they are typed so a wrong type still fails.

enabled.description: Deploy the bundled Valkey. false requires externalRedis.url and externalRedis.cacheUrl.

architecture.description: Only standalone is supported; replication is refused by _validate.tpl with an explanation.

tag.description: A pinned tag -- never empty, never latest (#1200). Enforced by _validate.tpl rather than here, deliberately: a schema failure is an opaque path, and `helm upgrade --reuse-values` from a subchart-era release carries the subchart's tag `latest`, so that operator needs the guard's message saying what to pass instead.

enabled.description: Must be false: the bundled Valkey has no password support (REDIS_URL carries none).

commonConfiguration.description: Appended to the rendered valkey.conf after the chart's own bind/port/dir lines.

enabled.description: Requires a CNI that ENFORCES NetworkPolicy (Calico, Cilium). kind's default kindnetd admits the objects and ignores them.

scheduledJobs.description: Scheduled maintenance CronJobs (templates/cronjobs.yaml, #1157). Master switch off by default so an upgrade creates nothing; prune jobs are additionally off individually because they delete data.

timeZone.description: IANA zone name for CronJob .spec.timeZone (Kubernetes 1.27+). Empty = controller default (UTC on almost every cluster).

resources.description: Passed through with toYaml. Open: the chart is not the authority on the ResourceRequirements schema.

notifyDueSoon.description: manage.py notify_due_soon — due-date notifications for opted-in assignees.

schedule.description: Standard 5-field cron expression, interpreted in scheduledJobs.timeZone.

notifyStaleCards.description: manage.py notify_stale_cards — staleness notifications for opted-in users.

schedule.description: Standard 5-field cron expression, interpreted in scheduledJobs.timeZone.

pruneBoardEvents.description: manage.py prune_board_events — DELETES board change-feed events older than BOARD_EVENT_RETENTION_DAYS.

schedule.description: Standard 5-field cron expression, interpreted in scheduledJobs.timeZone.

pruneNotifications.description: manage.py prune_notifications — DELETES notifications older than NOTIFICATION_RETENTION_DAYS.

schedule.description: Standard 5-field cron expression, interpreted in scheduledJobs.timeZone.

demo.description: Public demo mode (#1180). Off by default; nothing renders unless enabled. The cross-field rules (a published login is required, charset limits, no SSO/SMTP/media PVC, NetworkPolicy on) are render-time guards in templates/_validate.tpl.

loginHint.description: The PUBLISHED visitor credential, printed on the login page.

adminPassword.description: Demo site admin password. Never published.

memberPassword.description: Password of the seeded member accounts. Not published.

schedule.description: Minute/hour cron expression, always evaluated in UTC. Also rendered as the backend's DEMO_RESET_SCHEDULE, which drives the visitor countdown.

failedJobsHistoryLimit.description: At least 1, so a failed reset stays visible to an operator.

resources.description: Seed hook and reset pods. Passed through with toYaml.

userRate.description: DEMO_USER_THROTTLE_RATE: ceiling on the one shared visitor account's `user` throttle scope. Empty keeps the normal rate.

containerDefaults.description: LimitRange defaults for containers that declare no requests/limits.
